mapper.sql: sale_targets.id AS id, sale_targets.company_id AS companyId, companies.name AS companyName, sale_targets.sale_target_code AS targetCode, sale_targets.target_name AS targetName, sale_targets.team_target_amount AS targetAmount, sale_targets.employee_id AS employeeId, employees.name AS employeeName, sale_targets.currency_center_id AS currencyId, currency_centers.symbol AS currencySymbol, sale_targets.organization_target AS organizationTarget, sale_targets.indicator_first AS indicatorFirst, sale_targets.indicator_second AS indicatorSecond, sale_targets.indicator_third AS indicatorThird, ( SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(customer_markets.name ORDER BY customer_markets.name SEPARATOR ', ') FROM sale_target_customer_markets INNER JOIN customer_markets ON customer_markets.id = sale_target_customer_markets.market_id WHERE sale_target_customer_markets.is_active = 1 AND customer_markets.is_active = 1 AND sale_target_customer_markets.sale_target_id = sale_targets.id ) AS marketNames, sale_targets.period_id AS periodId, sale_target_periods.period_name AS periodName, sale_targets.is_approve AS isApprove, sale_targets.is_close AS isClose

FROM sale_targets LEFT JOIN companies ON companies.id = sale_targets.company_id LEFT JOIN employees ON employees.id = sale_targets.employee_id LEFT JOIN currency_centers ON currency_centers.id = sale_targets.currency_center_id LEFT JOIN sale_target_periods ON sale_target_periods.id = sale_targets.period_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sale_targets ( year, company_id, employee_id, target_name, team_target_amount, currency_center_id, organization_target, indicator_first, indicator_second, indicator_third, period_id, created, created_by ) VALUES ( YEAR(NOW()), #{salesTarget.companyId}, #{salesTarget.employeeId}, #{salesTarget.targetName}, #{salesTarget.targetAmount}, #{salesTarget.currencyId}, #{salesTarget.organizationTarget}, #{salesTarget.indicatorFirst}, #{salesTarget.indicatorSecond}, #{salesTarget.indicatorThird}, #{salesTarget.periodId}, NOW(), #{salesTarget.createdBy} )
mapper.update: UPDATE sale_targets SET is_active = 0, modified = NOW(), modified_by = #{userId} WHERE id = #{id} AND is_active = 1
mapper.select: SELECT month_id FROM sale_target_details WHERE is_active = 1 AND sale_target_id = #{saleTargetId}
mapper.update: UPDATE sale_target_details SET is_active = #{value}, modified = NOW(), modified_by = #{userId} WHERE sale_target_id = #{saleTargetId} AND is_active = 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sale_target_details ( sale_target_id, month_id, created, created_by ) VALUES ( #{saleTargetId}, #{monthId}, NOW(), #{userId} )
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM sale_target_employees WHERE is_active = 1 AND sale_target_id = #{saleTargetId}

SELECT sale_target_employees.id AS id, employees.id AS employeeId, employees.name AS employeeName, employee_target_existing AS targetAmountExisting, organization_target_employee_existing AS targetOrgExisting, employee_target_new AS targetAmountNew, organization_target_employee_new AS targetOrgNew FROM sale_target_employees INNER JOIN employees ON sale_target_employees.employee_id = employees.id AND employees.is_active = 1 WHERE sale_target_employees.is_active = 1 AND sale_target_employees.sale_target_id = #{saleTargetId}

SELECT customers.id AS id, customers.name AS name FROM sale_target_employee_organizations INNER JOIN customers ON sale_target_employee_organizations.customer_id = customers.id WHERE sale_target_employee_organizations.is_active = 1 AND sale_target_employee_organizations.sale_target_employee_id = #{saleTargetEmployeeId}

SELECT customer_markets.id AS id, customer_markets.name AS name FROM sale_target_customer_markets INNER JOIN customer_markets ON sale_target_customer_markets.market_id = customer_markets.id WHERE sale_target_customer_markets.is_active = 1 AND customer_markets.is_active = 1 AND sale_target_customer_markets.sale_target_id = #{saleTargetId} ORDER BY customer_markets.name ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE sale_target_employees SET is_active = #{value}, modified = NOW(), modified_by = #{userId} WHERE sale_target_id = #{saleTargetId} AND is_active = 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sale_target_employees ( sale_target_id, employee_id, employee_target_existing, organization_target_employee_existing, employee_target_new, organization_target_employee_new, created, created_by ) VALUES ( #{salesTargetEmployee.saleTargetId}, #{salesTargetEmployee.employeeId}, #{salesTargetEmployee.targetAmountExisting}, #{salesTargetEmployee.organizationTargetAmountExisting}, #{salesTargetEmployee.targetAmountNew}, #{salesTargetEmployee.organizationTargetAmountNew}, NOW(), #{salesTargetEmployee.createdBy} )
INSERT INTO sale_target_employee_organizations ( sale_target_employee_id, customer_id, created, created_by ) VALUES ( #{salesTargetEmployeeId}, #{organizationId}, NOW(), #{userId} )
mapper.update: UPDATE sale_target_customer_markets SET is_active = #{value}, modified = NOW(), modified_by = #{userId} WHERE sale_target_id = #{saleTargetId} AND is_active = 1
